method: The A2A side uses the path selected by the corpus label: the real run_workflow entrypoint for workflow variants and the real local Phase2Coordinator for coordinator variants. The baseline side calls the same read-only evidence source and deterministic solution designer directly. Each path is scored against its own literal terminal and cause expectations. No union match is used.
limits: Small synthetic sample; not a general benchmark.
Deterministic fakes test orchestration and contracts, not model reasoning.
The baseline has no A2A protocol trace, discovery, retry, or timeout semantics.
Cases that depend on A2A protocol behavior or the full report/approval workflow are not applicable to the baseline.
No hosted model, provider, external system, credential, or real data is used.
No latency, cost, savings, or productivity outcome is claimed.
